spy.name: The Man in the Brown Coat

hints.text: Kapral o wpół do jedenastej idzie do Winiarni. Pół godziny, jak w zegarku.
hints.gloss: At half past ten the Corporal goes to the Winiarnia. Half an hour, like clockwork.
hints.note: The Corporal leaves St Mary's post for the Winiarnia (north-west corner) at 22:30 and stays about half an hour. His post is empty meanwhile.

hints.text: Jak bije północ, żołnierz spod Sukiennic idzie do kaprala. Przejście stoi puste.
hints.gloss: When midnight strikes, the soldier from the Cloth Hall goes to the Corporal. The passage stands empty.
hints.note: At midnight the Cloth Hall sentry walks to St Mary's for the change of the watch: the Cloth Hall passage is unguarded for a few minutes.

hints.text: U Matki Weroniki na zachodniej pierzei za grosz schowają każdego. Nawet przed Austriakiem.
hints.gloss: At Mother Weronika's on the west row they'll hide anyone for a coin. Even from an Austrian.
hints.note: The house with the red lantern on the west row will hide a hunted man in a paid room.

hints.text: Unser Mann im grauen Rock meldet alles dem Korporal bei St. Marien.
hints.gloss: Our man in the grey coat reports everything to the Corporal at St Mary's.
hints.note: The grey-coated informer reports to the Corporal at St Mary's post. Stop him before he gets there.

hints.text: Um Mitternacht Ablösung bei St. Marien. Endlich.
hints.gloss: Relief at St Mary's at midnight. At last.
hints.note: The Cloth Hall sentry is relieved at St Mary's at midnight and leaves his post to get there.

hints.text: Halb elf. Ein Glas in der Weinstube, dann zurück auf Posten.
hints.gloss: Half past ten. A glass in the wine-house, then back to my post.
hints.note: The Corporal himself: at half past ten he takes a glass at the Winiarnia, then returns to St Mary's.

hints.text: Bis zum Rathaus und kehrt. Bis zum Rathaus und kehrt. Jede Nacht.
hints.gloss: Up to the Town Hall and about turn. Up to the Town Hall and about turn. Every night.
hints.note: Rynek patrol B turns at the Town Hall end; while he walks back east, the Town Hall side is out of his sight.
The smuggler takes the muskets into the safe-house cellar by St Adalbert's tonight: he uses the cellar door in the south-east corner, never the front.
The informer runs to the Corporal at St Mary's post with whatever he has seen.

hints.text: Od Nowego Roku akcyza na sól podwójna. Z czego żyć?
hints.gloss: From the New Year the salt excise doubles. What are we to live on?
hints.note: Rumour: the Austrian excise will double the salt tax at the New Year.

hints.text: Hejnał urwał się w pół nuty, jak za Tatarów. To znak.
hints.gloss: The hejnał broke off mid-note, like in the Tatar days. It's a sign.
hints.note: Rumour: the trumpeter broke off the hejnał and did not finish it: a sign.

journal.blurb: The smuggler meets a Vistula boatman in the docks-side alley. Something heavier than salt is coming up the river.

storylines.title: The delivery
storylines.note: The smuggler leaves the safe-house door to meet a Vistula boatman at the cart in the docks-side alley. Get within 3.5 m while they talk and they break off.

steps.text: Keep the cellar shut. I'll not be long.
Salt from Wieliczka, the manifest says. Under the salt, forty muskets.
And the customs man at the Vistula gate?
Paid till Candlemas. The barge leaves at the fourth bell.
Then the cellar takes them tonight. Go, before the watch comes round.
Not here. Walk on, friend.
steps.label: spooked

steps.text: Another night, then.

journal.blurb: The bishop's party walks to St Mary's for Compline, with an Austrian official at his elbow.

storylines.title: The procession
storylines.note: The bishop's party walks to St Mary's for Compline at 21:30 and comes out at 22:15. Their movement is their schedule; this adds the talk.

steps.text: Compline, gentlemen. Let us not keep the vicar waiting.
His Excellency the Governor sends his regards, Your Grace.
And his soldiers to count my congregation, I expect.
Mind the ice on the steps, Your Grace.
Your Grace. The doors are open.
Pray for Kraków. She will need it before spring.
Vienna prays for order, Your Grace. Order first.
The lantern, Your Grace. This way.

journal.blurb: A man in a grey coat shadows strangers between the Cloth Hall lanterns, and runs to the watch.

storylines.title: The informer
storylines.note: Pass within 8 m of the police informer, in his sight, and he shadows you at 6 m for two minutes, then reports you to the St Mary's post, who comes looking. Put 22 m between you and he loses you. If a false pamphlet was planted on him (Mission flag decoy_planted) he sends the corporal to the Florian Gate instead.

steps.text: Now who walks the Rynek after curfew?
Corporal! A stranger, skulking about the Cloth Hall. I followed him myself.
Corporal! Read this: Jacobins meeting at the Florian Gate, tonight. They're there now!
Show me.
The Florian Gate? Come on, then.
Gone. Devil take him.
steps.label: lost
